heading.en: Why does soda fizz when opened?

hook.en: Soda is bottled under high CO₂ pressure. Open it and the pressure falls — so does the gas solubility.
hook.kn: ಸೋಡಾವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು CO₂ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ತೆರೆದಾಗ ಒತ್ತಡ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗಿ ಅನಿಲದ ವಿಲೇಯತೆಯೂ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Soda is bottled under high CO₂ pressure. Open it and the pressure falls — so does the gas solubility.
narration.kn: ಸೋಡಾವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು CO₂ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿ ತುಂಬಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ತೆರೆದಾಗ ಒತ್ತಡ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗಿ ಅನಿಲದ ವಿಲೇಯತೆಯೂ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The partial pressure of a gas over a solution is proportional to its mole fraction in the solution: $p = K_H x$. A larger $K_H$ means lower solubility. Gas solubility falls as temperature rises.
body.kn: ಅನಿಲದ ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡ ದ್ರಾವಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದರ ಮೋಲ್ ಭಿನ್ನರಾಶಿಗೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ: p = K_H x.

narration.en: The partial pressure of a gas over a solution is proportional to its mole fraction in the solution: $p = K_H x$. A larger $K_H$ means lower solubility. Gas solubility falls as temperature rises.
narration.kn: ಅನಿಲದ ಆಂಶಿಕ ಒತ್ತಡ ದ್ರಾವಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದರ ಮೋಲ್ ಭಿನ್ನರಾಶಿಗೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ: p = K_H x.

say.en: Gas above a liquid keeps dissolving and escaping. Push the piston down, the pressure rises, and more gas dissolves.
The partial pressure of the gas is proportional to its mole fraction in the solution.
So p against x is a straight line through the origin; its slope is K_H. A bigger K_H means the gas is less soluble.
Nitrogen at 293 K has K_H of 76.48 kilobar. At 0.987 bar its mole fraction in water is tiny.
Soda bottles, the bends in divers, and low oxygen at altitude are all Henry's law in action.

body.en: "Like dissolves like": polar solutes dissolve in polar solvents. Solubility of a solid changes with temperature according to whether dissolving absorbs or releases heat; pressure has little effect.
body.kn: "ಸಮಾನವು ಸಮಾನವನ್ನು ಕರಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ": ಧ್ರುವೀಯ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯಗಳು ಧ್ರುವೀಯ ದ್ರಾವಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕರಗುತ್ತವೆ.

caption.en: Henry's law: mole fraction of a dissolved gas rises in proportion to its partial pressure. Change K_H to compare gases.

tryThis.en: Set K_H = 34.9 kbar (oxygen) and compare with 76.5 kbar (nitrogen): oxygen is more soluble.
Double the pressure: the dissolved amount doubles.

narration.en: Henry's law: mole fraction of a dissolved gas rises in proportion to its partial pressure. Change K_H to compare gases. Set K_H = 34.9 kbar (oxygen) and compare with 76.5 kbar (nitrogen): oxygen is more soluble. Double the pressure: the dissolved amount doubles.

problem.en: K_H for N₂ in water at 293 K is 76.48 kbar. Find the mole fraction of N₂ dissolved when its partial pressure is 0.987 bar.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. K_H for N₂ in water at 293 K is 76.48 kbar. Find the mole fraction of N₂ dissolved when its partial pressure is 0.987 bar.

narration.en: Recap. p = K_H x. Higher K_H → lower solubility. Gas solubility falls as temperature rises.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. p = K_H x. ಹೆಚ್ಚು K_H → ಕಡಿಮೆ ವಿಲೇಯತೆ. ತಾಪ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದಂತೆ ಅನಿಲದ ವಿಲೇಯತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ.
